title: Call to unimplemented function _pthread_attr_setschedpolicy (Perfect Cell 1.2.1)
author: postredaction
body:
### Describe the feature or issue.

Perhaps this version of the game is too old for TouchHLE? (early 2012) It is very difficult to get an earlier version.
